autism_enjoyer_08: On Day 4 Bastian Enjoyer took a post at R-F23 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He laughs at exactly the wrong moments, and the men liked him for it.

A shell burst over R-F23 and threw Bastian Enjoyer into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bastian Enjoyer raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F23. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.
guapoo007_: Dorian "Mole" Guapoo arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo moved a lucky button to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.
magnusmadsen37: At the depot, Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen had practised answering to his name. At R-F18, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. Verdel Ridge is lost. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
At Lantern Hill, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen's hands still remember being a tailor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
A patient at the aid post asked Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.
marquis_de_lafayette1757_1834: Nobody saw Matthias Lafayette arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F12, and a quiet stretcher bearer under it.
One of the first hundred, Matthias Lafayette was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Matthias Lafayette shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Matthias Lafayette folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Matthias Lafayette read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Matthias Lafayette put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.

Valentin Zle and Matthias Lafayette split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home reached Matthias Lafayette before dusk. Matthias Lafayette read it twice and slept a little easier.
projectpuffypenguin: Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy came up on Day 3 carrying news from Brennmoor. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
The trench wall shook against Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.

Yann Vee wrote a letter for Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's mother, because Saint could not find the words. Saint signed it. A letter from home reached Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy before dusk. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy read it twice and slept a little easier.
r.raphoto: They issued Lucien Raphoto a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a frozen apple in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Lucien Raphoto, volunteer number 60, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Lucien Raphoto wrote a list of things to buy on leave. It began with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Lucien Raphoto polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Otto Valiantlyval pulled Lucien Raphoto out of a flooded shell hole at the Brickworks. Neither of them has mentioned it since. Both of them remember. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Lucien Raphoto could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Lucien Raphoto's hands still remember being a medical student's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Lucien Raphoto began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Nobody else in S-F13 wanted the stripes. Lucien Raphoto said yes. Lance Corporal.
